answer: Stop sybils with an umber karst passage: an agent stakes an umber bond to enter a karst passage and earns one crystal token for timed work inside it. Verifiers void a token whose work is copied, outsourced, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bonds and tokens at 17x honest cost each: each crystal fits one passage and one bond, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents stake once and keep rights.
